SELECT DISTINCT t.class_number, t.class_name, t.subtitle, t.class_description, t.class_image, t.user_number, t.instructor, t.instructor_avatar, t.level, t.capacity, t.price, t.materials_included, t.curriculum, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.class_time, t.days, t.duration_weeks, t.is_daily, t.class_category_number, ST_AsText(t.location) AS location, c.class_category_name AS categoryName FROM tb_class t LEFT JOIN tb_class_category c ON t.class_category_number = c.class_category_number WHERE 1=1
AND c.class_category_name = #{categoryName}
AND ( t.class_name LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR t.subtitle LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR t.instructor LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY t.class_number DESC
